name: jev-guard
description: Probability-scored guardrails for Claude Code: deny rule-breaking edits and unasked-for deploys, route your own docs into each prompt, and check the final answer against the turn's own evidence.

denyThreshold.title: Deny threshold
denyThreshold.description: Minimum Jev probability that an edit or command breaks a rule before the call is denied.

routeMemories.title: Route docs into prompts
routeMemories.description: Score memory and rule files against each prompt and attach the best matches as context. Needs memoryDir and/or ruleFiles.

routeCount.title: Routed files per prompt
routeCount.description: How many memory/rule files (max) are attached to each prompt.

routeThreshold.title: Route threshold
routeThreshold.description: Minimum Jev probability for a memory/rule file to be attached to a prompt.

memoryDir.title: Memory directory
memoryDir.description: Directory holding a MEMORY.md index of '- [Title](file.md) — hook' lines. Empty disables memory routing.

ruleFiles.title: Routable project docs
ruleFiles.description: Comma-separated paths, relative to the session cwd, that the router may attach (e.g. docs/style.md,docs/testing.md). Empty disables doc routing.

verifyAnswers.title: Check final answers
verifyAnswers.description: Score each main-loop answer against the turn's tool results (unbacked claims, false 'merged', promises, asking for on-disk credentials, hidden red checks) and submit one correction prompt on a hit.

answerThreshold.title: Answer-check threshold
answerThreshold.description: Minimum Jev probability for an answer finding to trigger the correction prompt.

gatedSkillPrefixes.title: User-invoked skill prefixes
gatedSkillPrefixes.description: Comma-separated prefixes of skills whose description says they trigger ONLY on explicit invocation; a call the prompt did not ask for is denied. Empty disables the gate.

slowThreshold.title: Background threshold
slowThreshold.description: Minimum Jev probability that a Bash command is long-running before it is moved to the background.

agentRouting.title: Subagent model routing
agentRouting.description: Let Jev downgrade lookup-style Explore/general-purpose subagents to a cheaper model. Off: subagents keep their configured model.
